question: Which pair is NOT correct regarding dams and the states they are situated in?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Shanti Sagara-Kerala**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Shanti Sagara – Kerala:**

 
 
• This pair is incorrect.
 
• Shanti Sagara is actually located in **Karnataka**, not Kerala.
 
• **It is a major reservoir formed by the Bhadra Dam **on the Bhadra River.
 
• It's a crucial part of the s**tate's irrigation and hydroelectric power infrastructure.**
 
• It helps sustain crops and support the livelihoods of local farmers.
 
• The **dam also generates hydroelectric power, **contributing to the energy needs of the state.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• **Stanley Reservoir – Tamil Nadu:**

 
 
• This is a correct pair.
 
• **Stanley Reservoir, also known as Mettur Dam**, is located in Tamil Nadu.
 
• It is a m**ajor irrigation project on the Cauvery Rive**r.
 
• The **construction work of this dam commenced in the year 1925** and was completed in the year 1934.
 
• The length of the dam is 1615 m and the maximum storage height is 120 feet.
 
 
 
• **Nagarjuna Sagar – Andhra Pradesh:**
 
 
• **​**This is also a correct pair.
 
• Nagarjuna Sagar Dam is a **massive hydroelectric project on the Krishna River in Andhra Pradesh.**
 
• This is the largest and highest masonry dam in the world.
 
• The dam was constructed between 1955 and 1967 and has a total capacity of 11.56 km3.
 
 
 
• **Gobind Sagar – Himachal Pradesh:**
 
 
• This is another correct pair.
 
• Gobind Sagar is a **reservoir formed by the Bhakra Nangal Dam **on the Sutlej River in Himachal Pradesh.
